audit_boundary: The v6 audit preserves the fixed quality-independent Candidate200 mechanism predicates and adds direct root/reviewer rollout checks. Root may read design-admission for implementation binding and packet projection, but may not pre-read the reviewer-owned paired-scope target. A current reviewer may read only the exact paired-scope target and may not read the projected closed design-admission source, including in a mixed invocation. Missing reviewers are not counted as read-closure success; they remain cardinality and admission failures.
